title: parosela cyanea
intro: Parosela cyanea, commonly known as the blue parosela, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is a traditional medicinal plant used in various cultures, primarily in the Amazon region, for its therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Parosela cyanea include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments, such as fever, respiratory issues, and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Parosela cyanea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
